title: Undo/redo with a bounded history, multi-select with copy and paste, autosave and recovery, a versioned project, field validation with a visible message, and stale-result marking tied to the plan hash

fixture.spec: tests/ui/g8-editing.spec.js (six tests, each in a fresh browser context with empty storage) run by scripts/run_workbench_journeys.py against a CPU-only server; tests/test_project_versioning.py against FastAPI's TestClient
fixture.start: the SiN waveguide 2D example of the workbench (structure waveguide 8 x 0.65 x 0.4 um, point source, monitors input and output, 1000 steps)
fixture.history: y span edits 0.8 then 0.9; then 85 edits of the region's time steps 200 .. 284 followed by 80 undo clicks and one more
fixture.selection: Ctrl+click on waveguide and source; Duplicate all; Ctrl+C; Ctrl+V; Delete all from the selection panel; Paste from the ribbon
fixture.autosave: y span 0.8 and a duplicate, then page.reload(); then one more edit
fixture.versioning: three edits (y span 0.8, x span 7, y span 0.75), Ctrl+S, the downloaded JSON posted to /api/validate unchanged and with steps + 1, then one undo
fixture.validation: y span -1, '', 1e999, 0.8; region time steps 5; the autosaved project with steps 5 posted to /api/validate
fixture.stale: CPU run of 300 steps; Layout; y span 0.8; open the field visualizer; undo; time steps 320; y span -3
fixture.api: demo projects through Project.content_hash, stamped, content_matches, Project.save/load, /api/validate, /api/jobs, /api/gds/export

reference_method: the browser's own storage (localStorage torchfdtd.project.v1) read by the spec, the server's /api/validate (plan_hash, revision, content_sha256, stored_content_sha256_matches) and /api/jobs/{id} (plan_hash, revision), and Python recomputation of the content hash in tests/test_project_versioning.py

observables.name: undo_redo
observables.definition: y span after undo, undo, redo, Ctrl+Y: 0.8, 0.65, 0.8, 0.9

observables.name: history_bound
observables.definition: after 85 time-step edits, 80 undos restore the value of the fifth edit (204) and an 81st undo changes nothing

observables.name: multi_select
observables.definition: two tree rows selected, the panel reads '2 objects selected'; Duplicate all adds waveguide_copy and source_copy (object count 7); Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V adds waveguide_copy_copy and source_copy_copy (9), the pasted structure at x + 0.4 um with the original size and a new id; Delete all removes them (7); Paste from the ribbon restores 9

observables.name: autosave_recovery
observables.definition: localStorage holds the project with a 64-hex content_sha256 and revision >= 2; after reload the tree lists waveguide_copy, the log reads 'Recovered the autosaved project "<name>" at revision <n>' with no mismatch warning, the title shows rev <n>, y span reads 0.8 and the next edit is revision n + 1

observables.name: versioned_project
observables.definition: three edits raise revision by exactly 3; the saved JSON carries that revision, schema_version 1 and a 64-hex content_sha256; /api/validate reports stored_content_sha256_matches true for the file and false after steps + 1; the log names the revision and the first 12 hex digits of the hash; an undo raises the revision to start + 4

observables.name: field_validation
observables.definition: 'y span must be at least 0.001 um.' for -1 with aria-invalid, a toast ending 'The previous value is kept.' and a log line; 'y span must be a finite number in um.' for '' and 1e999; the stored size stays 0.65 until 0.8 is accepted; 'time steps must be at least 10.' for 5 with the stored steps still 1000; /api/validate answers 422 for steps 5

observables.name: stale_marking
observables.definition: after the run the banner is hidden and the field label has no STALE; after Layout the results stay listed and the banner stays hidden; after y span 0.8 the validate plan_hash differs from the job's, the banner reads 'Stale results: the project changed since run revision <r>', the results tree and the field view carry the stale class and the field label starts with STALE; after undo the plan_hash equals the job's and the banner is hidden; after time steps 320 it is visible; after y span -3 (rejected) it stays visible with the field error shown

observables.name: content_hash_api
observables.definition: content_hash ignores revision and content_sha256, changes with steps; stamped() sets the hash; content_matches() is None, True, False as documented; revision -1 and a malformed hash are refused; Project.save/load keeps both fields; /api/jobs carries the plan_hash and revision of the submitted project, unchanged after completion; names, the revision and precision do not change the plan_hash, geometry and steps do

acceptance.all_observables: exact values as listed; every spec passes on its first attempt with zero page errors
acceptance.stale_scope: staleness follows plan_hash of torchfdtd.plan: geometry, mesh, materials, sources, monitors, boundaries and steps; placement (backend, kernels, execution mode, precision) is outside the hash by design and is printed in the run summary instead
acceptance.source_of_limits: COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md G8-04; the values are this case's declaration

not_yet_covered: dragging in a viewport moves the dragged object only, not the whole multi-selection
undo of edits made in the materials, boundary, mesh-node and source-signal dialogs is exercised only through the same remember() path, not by a spec
a precision or backend change alone does not mark results stale (documented, not asserted)
the browser-storage-full path (persist() toast) is not simulated

notes: Declared on branch g8-gui from 73203d2 before the recorded run. The version fields revision and content_sha256 are additions to schema 1 with defaults; a file that carries them is refused by builds before this change (extra keys are errors), which COMPATIBILITY.md records.
